atoms.b: Setting a goal is great, but you can also feel ((++overwhelmed happy)) when a goal seems hard to reach.
Breaking down your goal into ((++smaller huge)) goals can make the process easier.
Reaching a goal is like climbing a set of ((++stairs stars)). Each smaller goal is one step of the staircase.

instruction.text: Luca wants to read 4 books in 8 weeks. He brainstormed some ideas for how to reach his goal. Select the smaller steps that are useful.
instruction.sound: Luca wants to read fourbooks in 8 weeks. He brainstormed some ideas for how to reach his goal. Select the smaller steps that are useful.

objects.sound: find books I am excited to read
set a number of pages to read each day

feedback.wrong: Buying more books than he wants to read does not help Luca break down his goal. It can be distracting to have too many choices.
Choosing to start with a book that will take Luca longer to finish might be demotivating and could stop him achieving his goal.

instruction.text: Luca wants to read 4 books in 8 weeks. He brainstormed some ideas for how to reach his goal. Select the smaller steps that are useful.
instruction.sound: Luca wants to read fourbooks in 8 weeks. He brainstormed some ideas for how to reach his goal. Select the smaller steps that are useful.

objects.sound: complete one book every two weeks
read every evening before going to sleep

feedback.wrong: This is not a smaller step, and it is not realistic that Luca can read 4 books in one day.
Starting with something you are not excited about will make it harder. Instead, Luca should start with a book he is excited to read.

atoms.text: Henry dreams of becoming a concert pianist, but first, he needs to learn how to play. He just got his grandma’s old piano and finally has the opportunity to play every day.

instruction.text: Select all the steps that might help Henry reach his goal.

atoms.text: Phillip has received his school report, and he isn’t happy with how he is doing in maths. Now, his goal is to improve his marks and not fall behind in class.

instruction.text: Select all the steps that might help Phillip reach his goal.
